title: PT Clinic Session Failure Rate
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pt:session
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(session_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by therapist_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often PT clinic session records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each therapist.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize session_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per therapist.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your PT clinic session data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
